name: Gondor Bow
game_text:
Bearer must be a <culture>Gondor</culture> Man.
If bearer is a knight, he or she is strength +1.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: Exert bearer to wound a minion he or she is skirmishing if that minion bears a fortification.
flavor_text: “…tall Duinhir with his sons, Duilin and Derufin, and five hundred bowmen.”
